eat.note: The Balcomie Clubhouse restaurant is golf dining outside this strict locality and not a café-led Craighead Eat.

providerChecks.officialRoutes: Fife Coastal Path verified and published as a cross-boundary route.

picnic.note: The Kilminning council picnic area is a separate coastal site and is not borrowed.

parking.note: Public Craighead/Fife Ness car park located from specialist access guidance; all unpublished details withheld.

toilets.note: No public toilet; golf clubhouse facilities are customer-only and outside the locality centre.

accessibility.note: No blanket path or coast accessibility claim; medical golf buggy hire does not establish public-site access.

boundaryRule: Golf and trail are independent category entries; Fife Ness, Kilminning, Crail and Balcomie do not carry Craighead.
